The full picture is now clear. I am structuring the answer with exact file paths and line numbers.

Schema and API definitions live in `proto/store/memo.proto` and `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`. Core extraction runs in `internal/markdown/markdown.go` via `ExtractAll`, `ExtractProperties`, and `GenerateSnippet`. Tag parsing is handled by `internal/markdown/parser/tag.go` and `internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`. Persistence orchestration is managed by `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` through `RebuildMemoPayload`. Recomputation is triggered by `CreateMemo` and `UpdateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` when content changes.

Response enrichment happens in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` and `memo_service_webhooks.go`, where snippets are generated and 64-character content previews are built. List filtering uses `internal/filter/schema.go` against payload JSON fields. Bulk rebuilds run via `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` `RunOnce`, though this is not wired to server startup. Mentions are extracted during creation through `resolveMentionTargets` using `ExtractAll`, but `RebuildMemoPayload` does not store them in the payload.

Location is user-set, not derived, so it is excluded from the derived metadata category.

## Summary

Memos derive **tags**, **property** (content flags + title), and **snippet** (plain-text preview) from markdown content. Tags and property are persisted in `memo.payload` and recomputed when content changes; snippet is computed on the fly when building API responses.

---

## Schema (what is derived)

**Store payload** — [`proto/store/memo.proto`](proto/store/memo.proto):

```7:22:proto/store/memo.proto
message MemoPayload {
  Property property = 1;
  // ...
  repeated string tags = 3;

  // The calculated properties from the memo content.
  message Property {
    bool has_link = 1;
    bool has_task_list = 2;
    bool has_code = 3;
    bool has_incomplete_tasks = 4;
    // The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present.
    string title = 5;
  }
```

**API surface** — [`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto`](proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto): `tags` (L240–241), `property` (L255–256), `snippet` (L265–266) are all `OUTPUT_ONLY`. `location` is user-set, not derived.

---

## Where computation happens

### 1. Core extractor — `internal/markdown/markdown.go`

Goldmark (GFM + custom `#tag` / `@mention` extensions) parses content once in a single AST walk.

| Function | Lines | Extracts |
|---|---|---|
| `ExtractAll` | 355–422 | Tags, mentions, and all `Property` fields in one pass |
| `ExtractProperties` | 192–241 | Property only (same node-kind logic) |
| `ExtractTags` | 142–170 | `#tag` tokens via custom `TagNode` |
| `GenerateSnippet` | 263–346 | Plain-text preview (strips code blocks, truncates at word boundary) |

**Property extraction rules** (lines 383–405 in `ExtractAll`; mirrored in `ExtractProperties`):

- **`title`**: plain text of the **first block-level H1** only (not H2+, not H1 after other blocks)
- **`has_link`**: any `KindLink` node (markdown links like `[text](url)`)
- **`has_code`**: code block, fenced code block, or inline code span
- **`has_task_list`**: any GFM task checkbox node
- **`has_incomplete_tasks`**: any unchecked task checkbox

**Tag extraction** — [`internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`](internal/markdown/parser/tag.go) (L73–149): `#word` inline tags; skips headings (`##`), tags inside links/images (`asMemoTagNode` at `markdown.go` L134–140).

**Mentions** — `ExtractAll` also collects `@username` tokens (L379–381), lowercased and deduplicated. These are **not** written into `memo.payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload`; they are used only for mention notifications.

### 2. Persistence orchestrator — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	// ...
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

Stored in DB column `memo.payload` (see [`store/memo.go`](store/memo.go) L51).

### 3. Response-time snippet — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`

```83:89:server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go
func (s *APIV1Service) getMemoContentSnippet(content string) (string, error) {
	snippet, err := s.MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)
	// ...
}
```

Called from [`memo_service_converter.go`](server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go) L76–80 (single memo) and L224–252 (batch list with relations). **Not stored**; recomputed on every read/conversion.

---

## What triggers recomputation

| Operation | File | Trigger | What is recomputed |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `memo_service.go` L108 | Always before `Store.CreateMemo` | `payload.tags`, `payload.property` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | `memo_service_comments.go` L56–59 | Delegates to `CreateMemo` | Same as create |
| **UpdateMemo** | `memo_service.go` L436–451 | Only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` | `payload.tags`, `payload.property` |
| **List/Get/Convert memo** | `memo_service_converter.go` | Every API response | `snippet` (from current content) |
| **Bulk rebuild (maintenance)** | `memopayload/runner.go` L27–72 `RunOnce` | Iterates all memos in batches | Full payload rewrite |

**Does not recompute payload:** updates to visibility, pinned, state, timestamps, location, attachments, or relations alone (`memo_service.go` L452–493). `SetMemoAttachments` / `SetMemoRelations` also do not touch payload.

`memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` exists for backfill/migration but is **not wired** into server startup (only `s3presign` runner is in [`server/server.go`](server/server.go) L162).

Markdown service is initialized with tag + mention extensions in [`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`](server/router/api/v1/v1.go) L47–51.

---

## How derived metadata is used (lists/previews/filters)

- **Snippet** — comment previews (`MemoCommentListView.tsx` L45), relation links (`MemoSnippetLink.tsx`), map cards (`UserMemoMap.tsx` L154), inbox notifications (`user_service_notifications.go` L323).
- **Tags** — sidebar tag tree, blur settings, list filtering (`internal/filter/schema.go` L173–178).
- **Property booleans** — CEL list filters (`has_task_list`, `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`; `schema.go` L186–228; documented in `memo_service.proto` L326–332). Frontend filter UI in `MemoFilters.tsx` / `useMemoFilters.ts`.
- **Property.title** — stored and exposed on API `Memo.property.title`, but no current frontend list/preview consumer found; title for outline UI is parsed client-side in `MemoOutline.tsx`.

---

## Evidence chain (end-to-end)

```
Content change
  → memo_service.go CreateMemo (L108) / UpdateMemo content path (L447)
  → memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload (runner.go L74)
  → markdown.ExtractAll (markdown.go L356)
  → stored in memo.payload (tags + property)

Any read/list
  → convertMemoFromStore (converter.go L47–50, L76–80)
  → property/tags from stored payload; snippet via GenerateSnippet (64 chars)
```
